title: Judge answer (B.5). One typed decision per call.
description: Kept to keywords structured outputs accept: no numeric or length constraints. The answer's vocabulary per decision and the confidence range [0, 1] are checked in eval/judge.py.

answer.description: Exactly one of the allowed answers listed in the prompt

confidence.description: Probability from 0 to 1 that the answer is correct

missing.description: Only when the question asks for it: the ids of the listed items that are absent
